_doc: Private-label detection per chain (docs/PROMOS-AND-PRIVATE-LABEL.md §3). prefixes = GS1 company prefixes the chain uses for its own brand (barcode starts with). names = words in the item name or manufacturer, matched as whole words. exclude = phrases that make a name match void. Measured on the 17-19.9.2026 files: Shufersal 7296073 = 2,715 barcodes, all exclusive to Shufersal; Carrefour 3560070/3560071 = ~500 (Carrefour France prefixes). Prefixes 7290116-7290121 are generic Israeli GS1 blocks shared by every chain - never list them.

hazihinam._note: 7297611 = own-import textiles (socks, underwear, polo shirts), 271 barcodes, exclusive

keshet._note: 'קשת' alone matches hair bows and rainbow cookies
